entries.title: II Samuel 7:3
segments: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that [is] in thine heart; for the LORD [is] with thee.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:6
segments: Whereas I have not dwelt in [any] house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:7

entries.title: II Samuel 7:8
segments: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel: {from following: Heb. from after}

words.text: Now therefore so shalt thou say

entries.title: II Samuel 7:9
segments: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great [men] that [are] in the earth. {out of...: Heb. from thy face}

words.text: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest

entries.title: II Samuel 7:12
segments: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:13
segments: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:14

words.text: , and he shall be my son

entries.title: II Samuel 7:15
segments: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took [it] from Saul, whom I put away before thee.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:16
segments: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:17
segments: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

words.text: , and according to all this vision

entries.title: II Samuel 7:18
segments: ¶Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD, and he said, Who [am] I, O Lord GOD? and what [is] my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:19
segments: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord GOD; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant's house for a great while to come. And [is] this the manner of man, O Lord GOD? {manner: Heb. law}

words.text: And this was yet a small thing
for a great while to come

entries.title: II Samuel 7:20
segments: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord GOD, knowest thy servant.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:21
segments: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know [them].

words.text: sake, and according to thine own heart

entries.title: II Samuel 7:22
segments: Wherefore thou art great, O LORD God: for [there is] none like thee, neither [is there any] God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:23
segments: And what one nation in the earth [is] like thy people, [even] like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, [from] the nations and their gods?

entries.title: II Samuel 7:24
segments: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel [to be] a people unto thee for ever: and thou, LORD, art become their God.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:25
segments: And now, O LORD God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish [it] for ever, and do as thou hast said.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:26
segments: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts [is] the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.

entries.title: II Samuel 7:27
segments: For thou, O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee. {revealed: Heb. opened the ear}

words.text: unto thee. {revealed: Heb. opened the ear}

segments: And now, O Lord GOD, thou [art] that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
